_: Bowling D32 (owner: room to walk between the lanes; a ball whose spin shows): the aisles between the pairs' settees and a lane ball's finger holes. Local to world: x = 1300 + X, y = 16.5 + Y, z = -420 - D; eye height is the floor + 5.2. Render: lune run tools/bake/attractions.luau, then a scene of the attractions (tools/review/attractions_export.luau on build/Attractions.rbxm) and render.py --views tools/review/views_bowling_feel.json. Committed pictures: docs/renders/bowling_feel/.
